title: device-authorization-report acceptance evidence

preconditions.const: Operations: identity.oauth-server.device-authorize, identity.oauth-server.device-approve, identity.oauth-server.device-deny, identity.oauth-server.device-token; exact inputs: client_id, device_code, user_code, scopes, interval; initial state: registered device client has no authorization grant

stimulus.const: Run identity.oauth-server.device-authorize then identity.oauth-server.device-approve then identity.oauth-server.device-deny then identity.oauth-server.device-token for success, failure, denial, outage, replay, cleanup, unknown-outcome cases using client_id, device_code, user_code, scopes, interval and capture every required artifact field

expected_outcome.const: Invariant: pending polling respects interval, approval issues one grant, denial returns access_denied, and expired or replayed codes issue no token; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden, outage=unavailable/unavailable, replay=denied/conflict, cleanup=pass/none, unknown-outcome=reconciled/unknown_commit; required artifact fields: device_code_digest, user_code_digest, poll_count, token_issued_count, terminal_status

actual_outcome.const: Invariant: pending polling respects interval, approval issues one grant, denial returns access_denied, and expired or replayed codes issue no token; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden, outage=unavailable/unavailable, replay=denied/conflict, cleanup=pass/none, unknown-outcome=reconciled/unknown_commit; required artifact fields: device_code_digest, user_code_digest, poll_count, token_issued_count, terminal_status

x-cross-field-rules: every observations[].artifact_sha256 value must equal one artifact_hashes[].sha256 value
artifact_hashes must bind the artifact-specific evidence object at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/artifacts/device-authorization-report.json
artifact_hashes must bind the separately captured coordinator execution receipt at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/executions/device-authorization-report.json
revalidation_revision is null exactly when tested_revision equals gate_execution_revision; otherwise it equals gate_execution_revision
input_root is SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON of input_manifest
